verdict.rationale: GitLab's own marketing says it can apply compliance controls in every pipeline and run SAST/DAST, with security findings shown directly in merge requests. That is a first-party compliance and quality control mechanism tied to the MR workflow. Nothing documents that these checks can block or gate a merge, or that custom merge checks can be defined, so the evidence shows visibility and pipeline controls rather than enforced merge checks. Partner tools such as CodeAnt are third-party and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented merge-blocking checks or approval rules, custom check definitions, policy-driven required pipelines or approvals, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
